citation.source: 7 CFR 210.10(c) — Fluid Milk component. Cup equivalent is a direct volume measure (1 cup served = 1 cup eq), minimum creditable serving 8 fluid ounces (1 cup).
citation.note: Definitional 1:1 crediting, not a derived factor — a cup eq of milk IS a cup of fluid milk served. Regulation also requires low-fat (1%, unflavored) or fat-free milk for the reimbursable meal pattern; this repo's milk.json does not model fat content, so that constraint is named here, not enforced.
